takeaways.text: AWS sales grew 19% to $28.8B and the segment earned $10.6B of operating profit — half of Amazon's total — as companies kept moving computing, and new AI work, onto its cloud.
takeaways.title: AWS growth re-accelerated

takeaways.text: Consolidated operating income jumped 60% from a year ago: North America earned $9.3B and International swung from a loss to a $1.3B profit as the regional store networks got more efficient.
takeaways.title: Operating income jumped 60%

takeaways.text: The holiday quarter set a sales record at $187.8B, up 10%, and net income nearly doubled to $20.0B — about 11 cents of every sales dollar stayed as profit.
takeaways.title: A record holiday quarter

verdict: Amazon's holiday quarter set records: sales rose 10% to $187.8B, AWS grew 19%, and operating income jumped 60% to $21.2B — and it kept $20.0B as profit.
